real.fares: BMRCL / BMTC / Karnataka RTO tables, transcribed

simulated.travel_time_observations: 199870 rows, generated by scripts/generate_dataset.py over the real topology
simulated.congestion_field: anchored to distance from the real centre, real road class and real junction degree, plus noise

not_used.real_time_traffic: no free source; commercial APIs are keyed

honesty_note: Real topology, simulated observations. The network is genuinely OpenStreetMap; the travel times over it are not measurements of anything and must never be presented as such.
